s0001.literal: Emperor Renzong, posthumous name Shengwen Qinxiao, taboo name Ayurbarwada, was the second son of Shunzong and the younger brother of Wuzong.
s0001.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong, posthumous name Shengwen Qinxiao, taboo name Ayurbarwada, was the second son of Shunzong and the younger brother of Wuzong.

s0002.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.
s0002.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.

s0003.literal: He was born in the third month of the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan, on bingzi day.
s0003.idiomatic: He was born in the third month of the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan, on bingzi day.

s0004.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the ninth year of Dade, Emperor Temür fell ill; the inner palace took charge of government; an edict ordered the Emperor and the empress dowager to leave and reside at Huaizhou.
s0004.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter of the ninth year of Dade, Emperor Temür fell ill; the inner palace took charge of government; an edict ordered the Emperor and the empress dowager to leave and reside at Huaizhou.

s0005.literal: In the twelfth month of winter of the tenth year, they reached Huaizhou; at every commandery and county passed through, lavish provisions had been set out — all were ordered removed; the entourage was strictly admonished not to disturb the people; and Commissioner of Affairs for Various Duties Wang Yi was instructed to investigate and report; the people were all moved and pleased.
s0005.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter of the tenth year, they reached Huaizhou; at every commandery and county passed through, lavish provisions had been set out — all were ordered removed; the entourage was strictly admonished not to disturb the people; and Commissioner of Affairs for Various Duties Wang Yi was instructed to investigate and report; the people were all moved and pleased.

s0006.literal: Spring, first month of the eleventh year — Emperor Temür died; at that time Khayishan was Prince of Huaining, commanding troops on the northern frontier; on wuzi day the Emperor and the empress dowager, hearing the death announcement, rushed to attend.
s0006.idiomatic: Spring, first month of the eleventh year — Emperor Temür died; at that time Khayishan was Prince of Huaining, commanding troops on the northern frontier; on wuzi day the Emperor and the empress dowager, hearing the death announcement, rushed to attend.

s0007.literal: On gengyin day they reached Weihui; passing the tomb of Bi Gan, the Emperor turned to those beside him and said, "Zhou was debauched within with women and poisoned the four seas; Bi Gan remonstrated, and Zhou cut out his heart — and so lost the realm.
s0007.idiomatic: On gengyin day they reached Weihui; passing the tomb of Bi Gan, the Emperor turned to those beside him and said, "Zhou was debauched within with women and poisoned the four seas; Bi Gan remonstrated, and Zhou cut out his heart — and so lost the realm.

s0008.literal: " He ordered Bi Gan sacrificed to at his tomb, as encouragement for later ages.
s0008.idiomatic: " He ordered Bi Gan sacrificed to at his tomb, as encouragement for later ages.

s0009.literal: Reaching the Zhang River, they met a great wind and snow; an old field-hand offered bowl-porridge; close attendants refused it.
s0009.idiomatic: Reaching the Zhang River, they met a great wind and snow; an old field-hand offered bowl-porridge; close attendants refused it.

s0010.literal: The Emperor said, "Formerly Emperor Guangwu of Han was once pressed by bandit soldiers and ate bean porridge.
s0010.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Formerly Emperor Guangwu of Han was once pressed by bandit soldiers and ate bean porridge.

s0011.literal: A great man who has not fully tasted hardship often does not know the difficulty of tillage and harvest, and so becomes arrogant and indolent.
s0011.idiomatic: A great man who has not fully tasted hardship often does not know the difficulty of tillage and harvest, and so becomes arrogant and indolent.

s0012.literal: " He ordered it fetched and eaten.
s0012.idiomatic: " He ordered it fetched and eaten.

s0013.literal: One bolt of damask was granted the old man, and he was comforted and sent away.
s0013.idiomatic: One bolt of damask was granted the old man, and he was comforted and sent away.

s0014.literal: Passing Handan, the Emperor instructed the county officials, "I fear the guards may behave unlawfully and clerks levy exactions, greatly burdening the people.
s0014.idiomatic: Passing Handan, the Emperor instructed the county officials, "I fear the guards may behave unlawfully and clerks levy exactions, greatly burdening the people.

s0015.literal: " He then ordered the princely tutors to tour and investigate.
s0015.idiomatic: " He then ordered the princely tutors to tour and investigate.

s0016.literal: Second month, xinhai day — they reached Dadu; the Emperor and the empress dowager entered the inner palace and wept to the full measure of grief; then went out again to reside at the old residence, daily entering morning and evening to weep and offer sacrifice.
s0016.idiomatic: Second month, xinhai day — they reached Dadu; the Emperor and the empress dowager entered the inner palace and wept to the full measure of grief; then went out again to reside at the old residence, daily entering morning and evening to weep and offer sacrifice.

s0017.literal: Left chancellor Ahutai and others secretly plotted to install Empress Boheljen as regent, with Prince of Anxi Ananda to assist her.
s0017.idiomatic: Left chancellor Ahutai and others secretly plotted to install Empress Boheljen as regent, with Prince of Anxi Ananda to assist her.

s0018.literal: At that time left chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan feigned illness, keeping watch at the side gate for three months in all, secretly holding the levers of power; outwardly he agreed with them, but at night sent men to inform the Emperor, "The Prince of Huaining is far off and cannot arrive suddenly; I fear change may arise without warning — we should strike first.
s0018.idiomatic: At that time left chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan feigned illness, keeping watch at the side gate for three months in all, secretly holding the levers of power; outwardly he agreed with them, but at night sent men to inform the Emperor, "The Prince of Huaining is far off and cannot arrive suddenly; I fear change may arise without warning — we should strike first.

s0019.literal: " Third month, bingyin day — the Emperor led the guards into the inner palace, summoned Ahutai and others, and charged them with disturbing the ancestral house laws; he ordered them seized; under interrogation they confessed; on wuchen day they were executed.
s0019.idiomatic: " Third month, bingyin day — the Emperor led the guards into the inner palace, summoned Ahutai and others, and charged them with disturbing the ancestral house laws; he ordered them seized; under interrogation they confessed; on wuchen day they were executed.

s0020.literal: Princes Kuokuochu, Yahudu, and others said, "Now the criminals are obtained; the crown prince is in truth a grandson of Shizu — the celestial throne should early be righted.
s0020.idiomatic: Princes Kuokuochu, Yahudu, and others said, "Now the criminals are obtained; the crown prince is in truth a grandson of Shizu — the celestial throne should early be righted.

s0021.literal: The Emperor said, "Princes, why speak such words!
s0021.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Princes, why speak such words!

s0022.literal: Those villains secretly joined with the inner palace and plotted disorder in Our house — therefore they were executed; would We wield authority to covet the sacred vessel?
s0022.idiomatic: Those villains secretly joined with the inner palace and plotted disorder in Our house — therefore they were executed; would We wield authority to covet the sacred vessel?

s0023.literal: The Prince of Huaining is Our elder brother — his taking the throne is fitting.
s0023.idiomatic: The Prince of Huaining is Our elder brother — his taking the throne is fitting.

s0024.literal: " Envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan from the northern frontier.
s0024.idiomatic: " Envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan from the northern frontier.

s0025.literal: Fifth month, yichou day — the Emperor and the empress dowager met Khayishan at Shangdu.
s0025.idiomatic: Fifth month, yichou day — the Emperor and the empress dowager met Khayishan at Shangdu.

s0026.literal: On jiashen day Khayishan ascended the throne.
s0026.idiomatic: On jiashen day Khayishan ascended the throne.

s0027.literal: Sixth month, guisi day — an edict installed the Emperor as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure.
s0027.idiomatic: Sixth month, guisi day — an edict installed the Emperor as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure.

s0028.literal: Envoys were dispatched in all directions to seek out classics and records far and wide; they were marked with jade-carved seals, and close attendants were ordered to keep charge of them.
s0028.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched in all directions to seek out classics and records far and wide; they were marked with jade-carved seals, and close attendants were ordered to keep charge of them.

s0029.literal: At that time someone presented the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》; the Emperor ordered Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Wang Yue and others to abridge and translate it.
s0029.idiomatic: At that time someone presented the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》; the Emperor ordered Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Wang Yue and others to abridge and translate it.

s0030.literal: The Emperor said, "To govern the realm, this one book suffices.
s0030.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "To govern the realm, this one book suffices.

s0031.literal: " He therefore ordered it published together with the 《Illustrated Classic of Filial Piety》 and the 《Biographies of Eminent Women》, and granted copies to officials below.
s0031.idiomatic: " He therefore ordered it published together with the 《Illustrated Classic of Filial Piety》 and the 《Biographies of Eminent Women》, and granted copies to officials below.

s0032.literal: Eleventh month, wuyin day — he received the jade book and took charge of the central secretariat and privy council.
s0032.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuyin day — he received the jade book and took charge of the central secretariat and privy council.

s0033.literal: Seventh month of the first year of Zhida — the Emperor instructed Supervisor Qu Chu, "You long served Us — deliberate with your colleagues and see that you follow the laws; for whatever Shizu never did and what has no precedent in established practice, take care not to do it.
s0033.idiomatic: Seventh month of the first year of Zhida — the Emperor instructed Supervisor Qu Chu, "You long served Us — deliberate with your colleagues and see that you follow the laws; for whatever Shizu never did and what has no precedent in established practice, take care not to do it.

s0034.literal: " Eighth month of the second year — the Ministry of Revenue was established; an edict made the crown prince concurrently minister of revenue; all officials and offices were admonished to revive discipline and law, value titles and appointments, and labor day and night toward achievement in service.
s0034.idiomatic: " Eighth month of the second year — the Ministry of Revenue was established; an edict made the crown prince concurrently minister of revenue; all officials and offices were admonished to revive discipline and law, value titles and appointments, and labor day and night toward achievement in service.

s0035.literal: Members of the heir apparent's household reported that Jin Prefecture offered a turquoise cave and requested envoys be sent to gather it; the Emperor said, "What is treasured is worthies alone — of what use is turquoise?
s0035.idiomatic: Members of the heir apparent's household reported that Jin Prefecture offered a turquoise cave and requested envoys be sent to gather it; the Emperor said, "What is treasured is worthies alone — of what use is turquoise?

s0036.literal: For such things hereafter, let Us hear no more.
s0036.idiomatic: For such things hereafter, let Us hear no more.

s0037.literal: " Earlier, a close attendant said a merchant was selling fine pearls; the Emperor said, "Our clothing and use have never favored adornment with pearls and gems; the lifeblood of the people must not be lightly squandered.
s0037.idiomatic: " Earlier, a close attendant said a merchant was selling fine pearls; the Emperor said, "Our clothing and use have never favored adornment with pearls and gems; the lifeblood of the people must not be lightly squandered.

s0038.literal: You should broadly advance worthy talent, admonishing one another with reverence, thrift, and love of the people — not guiding one another toward extravagance that devours the treasury.
s0038.idiomatic: You should broadly advance worthy talent, admonishing one another with reverence, thrift, and love of the people — not guiding one another toward extravagance that devours the treasury.

s0040.literal: Huaidong pacification commissioner Sadu presented a jade Guanyin, seven-treasures cap finial, treasure belt, and treasure saddle — all were declined, with admonition as before.
s0040.idiomatic: Huaidong pacification commissioner Sadu presented a jade Guanyin, seven-treasures cap finial, treasure belt, and treasure saddle — all were declined, with admonition as before.

s0041.literal: Supervisor Wang Yue reported on affairs; two eunuchs stood attendant; the Emperor asked, "Since ancient times eunuchs have ruined households and states — is this so?
s0041.idiomatic: Supervisor Wang Yue reported on affairs; two eunuchs stood attendant; the Emperor asked, "Since ancient times eunuchs have ruined households and states — is this so?

s0042.literal: Wang Yue replied, "Among eunuchs there are both good and bad — one only fears improper disposition.
s0042.idiomatic: Wang Yue replied, "Among eunuchs there are both good and bad — one only fears improper disposition.

s0044.literal: September — Hejian and other routes presented auspicious grain; there were cases of different fields sharing one ear and one stalk bearing several ears; Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Zhao Mengfu was ordered to paint illustrations, which were stored in the secretariat archives.
s0044.idiomatic: September — Hejian and other routes presented auspicious grain; there were cases of different fields sharing one ear and one stalk bearing several ears; Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Zhao Mengfu was ordered to paint illustrations, which were stored in the secretariat archives.

s0045.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, gengchen day — Khayishan died.
s0045.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, gengchen day — Khayishan died.

s0046.literal: On renwu day the Ministry of Revenue was abolished.
s0046.idiomatic: On renwu day the Ministry of Revenue was abolished.

s0047.literal: Because grand chancellors Toghto and Sanbaonu, grand councillor Leshi, right vice chancellor Baoba, left vice chancellor Mangqutemür, and associate administrator Wang Bi had altered and thrown into disorder the old regulations and spread poison among the people, central secretariat right chancellor Tasibuhua, director of privy council affairs Temür Buhua, and others were ordered to join in interrogating them.
s0047.idiomatic: Because grand chancellors Toghto and Sanbaonu, grand councillor Leshi, right vice chancellor Baoba, left vice chancellor Mangqutemür, and associate administrator Wang Bi had altered and thrown into disorder the old regulations and spread poison among the people, central secretariat right chancellor Tasibuhua, director of privy council affairs Temür Buhua, and others were ordered to join in interrogating them.

s0048.literal: On bingxu day Toghto, Sanbaonu, Leshi, Baoba, and Wang Bi were executed; Mangqutemür was beaten and banished to Hainan.
s0048.idiomatic: On bingxu day Toghto, Sanbaonu, Leshi, Baoba, and Wang Bi were executed; Mangqutemür was beaten and banished to Hainan.

s0049.literal: On renzi day the sun was red as ochre.
s0049.idiomatic: On renzi day the sun was red as ochre.

s0051.literal: Former ministers of Shizu's reign versed in government affairs and long of established reputation were summoned — grand councillor Cheng Pengfei, Dong Shixuan, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Li Qian, Junior Guardian Zhang Lü, right vice chancellors Chen Tianxiang, Shang Wen, and Liu Zheng, left vice chancellor Hao Tianting, censor-in-chief Dong Shizhen, Guest of the Heir Apparent Xiao Yi, associate administrators Liu Minzhong, Wang Siliang, and Han Congyi, attendant censor Zhao Junxin, surveillance commissioner Cheng Jufu, and Hangzhou Route darughachi Ahema — relay transport was granted for them to proceed to court and jointly deliberate common affairs.
s0051.idiomatic: Former ministers of Shizu's reign versed in government affairs and long of established reputation were summoned — grand councillor Cheng Pengfei, Dong Shixuan, junior tutor of the heir apparent Li Qian, junior guardian Zhang Lü, right vice chancellors Chen Tianxiang, Shang Wen, and Liu Zheng, left vice chancellor Hao Tianting, censor-in-chief Dong Shizhen, guest of the heir apparent Xiao Yi, associate administrators Liu Minzhong, Wang Siliang, and Han Congyi, attendant censor Zhao Junxin, surveillance commissioner Cheng Jufu, and Hangzhou Route darughachi Ahema — relay transport was granted for them to proceed to court and jointly deliberate common affairs.

s0052.literal: On jiawu day the guilt of left and right secretariat directors and six ministry officials who had attached themselves to Toghto and others was pardoned.
s0052.idiomatic: On jiawu day the guilt of left and right secretariat directors and six ministry officials who had attached themselves to Toghto and others was pardoned.

s0053.literal: On yiwei day officials were forbidden to impress soldiers for construction or to guard private residences.
s0053.idiomatic: On yiwei day officials were forbidden to impress soldiers for construction or to guard private residences.

s0054.literal: On dingyou day Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Temüder was made central secretariat right chancellor; Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze and Hanlin Academician Exemplar Li Meng were both made grand councillors.
s0054.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Temüder was made central secretariat right chancellor; supervisor of the heir apparent's household Wanze and Hanlin Academician Exemplar Li Meng were both made grand councillors.

s0055.literal: On wuxu day Tasibuhua and Bureau of Imperial Manufactures commissioner Shasha were both made censor-in-chief.
s0055.idiomatic: On wuxu day Tasibuhua and Bureau of Imperial Manufactures commissioner Shasha were both made censor-in-chief.

s0056.literal: On jihai day branch ministries of revenue were changed to branch secretariats.
s0056.idiomatic: On jihai day branch ministries of revenue were changed to branch secretariats.

s0057.literal: On gengzi day capital granary rice was sold at reduced price — one thousand shi daily — to relieve the poor.
s0057.idiomatic: On gengzi day capital granary rice was sold at reduced price — 1,000 shi daily — to relieve the poor.

s0058.literal: Construction at all locations was halted.
s0058.idiomatic: Construction at all locations was halted.

s0059.literal: Guangwu Kangli Guard was abolished; seals, relay certificates, and imperial letters were recovered, together with the commissions of its commanders of ten thousand households and other officials.
s0059.idiomatic: Guangwu Kangli Guard was abolished; seals, relay certificates, and imperial letters were recovered, together with the commissions of its commanders of ten thousand households and other officials.

s0060.literal: On xinchou day Tash Temür was made director of privy council affairs.
s0060.idiomatic: On xinchou day Tash Temür was made director of privy council affairs.

s0061.literal: On renyin day falconry offices were forbidden to rush relay transport and disturb the people.
s0061.idiomatic: On renyin day falconry offices were forbidden to rush relay transport and disturb the people.

s0062.literal: The central secretariat was ordered: for all transmitted orders not personally delivered, do not carry them out.
s0062.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered: for all transmitted orders not personally delivered, do not carry them out.

s0063.literal: Because the princes attended court, a general grant was made of thirty-nine thousand six hundred fifty taels of gold, one million eight hundred forty-nine thousand fifty taels of silver, two hundred twenty-three thousand two hundred seventy-nine ingots of notes, and four hundred seventy-two thousand four hundred eighty-eight bolts of silks and cloths.
s0063.idiomatic: Because the princes attended court, a general grant was made of 39,650 taels of gold, 1,849,050 taels of silver, 223,279 ingots of notes, and 472,488 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0064.literal: Second month — the Jade Hall Music Bureau was restored as the Ceremonial Phoenix Office; the Yanqing Office was changed to the Directorate of Merit Commissioners.
s0064.idiomatic: Second month — the Jade Hall Music Bureau was restored as the Ceremonial Phoenix Office; the Yanqing Office was changed to the Directorate of Merit Commissioners.

s0065.literal: On yisi day Karakorum and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariats were ordered to establish left chancellors as before; the remaining provinces were to have only two grand councillors each; remotely conferred appointments were not to participate.
s0065.idiomatic: On yisi day Karakorum and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariats were ordered to establish left chancellors as before; the remaining provinces were to have only two grand councillors each; remotely conferred appointments were not to participate.

s0066.literal: On wushen day transport of Buddhist scriptures printed in Jiangnan was halted.
s0066.idiomatic: On wushen day transport of Buddhist scriptures printed in Jiangnan was halted.

s0067.literal: On xinhai day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and powerful families were forbidden to seize mountain preserves without authority; the people were permitted to gather firewood.
s0067.idiomatic: On xinhai day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and powerful families were forbidden to seize mountain preserves without authority; the people were permitted to gather firewood.

s0068.literal: Alawadin's trade in Zhe salt was abolished; sheep for the Central Domestic Affairs Court were supplied.
s0068.idiomatic: Alawadin's trade in Zhe salt was abolished; sheep for the Central Domestic Affairs Court were supplied.

s0069.literal: Monks who violated regulations of the Bureau of Buddhist Affairs were forbidden.
s0069.idiomatic: Monks who violated regulations of the Bureau of Buddhist Affairs were forbidden.

s0070.literal: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to inspect and verify wasteland in Henan presented by Xiao Yunshi Buqa.
s0070.idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to inspect and verify wasteland in Henan presented by Xiao Yunshi Buqa.

s0071.literal: Minister of Works Xiao Zhen, for claiming merit at Central Capital while harming the people, was ordered stripped of his seals; all offices were to confine him; civilian fields occupied at Central Capital were returned.
s0071.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xiao Zhen, for claiming merit at Central Capital while harming the people, was ordered stripped of his seals; all offices were to confine him; civilian fields occupied at Central Capital were returned.

s0072.literal: The Jiangnan Branch Bureau of Transmission and Branch Bureau of Buddhist Affairs were abolished.
s0072.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Branch Bureau of Transmission and Branch Bureau of Buddhist Affairs were abolished.

s0073.literal: On jiazi day the moon encroached upon Zhen.
s0073.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon encroached upon Zhen.

s0074.literal: The Palace Domestic Service Bureau was promoted to the Palace Domestic Service Court, rank lower third grade.
s0074.idiomatic: The Palace Domestic Service Bureau was promoted to the Palace Domestic Service Court, rank lower third grade.

s0075.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng was ordered to head the Directorate of the Imperial Academy; they were instructed, "Schools are where talent comes from — you should frequently visit the academy to examine and test the students, encouraging their virtue and achievement.
s0075.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng was ordered to head the Directorate of the Imperial Academy; they were instructed, "Schools are where talent comes from — you should frequently visit the academy to examine and test the students, encouraging their virtue and achievement.

s0076.literal: " An order: "For households of princes and imperial sons-in-law in Jishan, Huailai, and Yongxing counties, corvée and tax obligations are the same as for commoners.
s0076.idiomatic: " An order: "For households of princes and imperial sons-in-law in Jishan, Huailai, and Yongxing counties, corvée and tax obligations are the same as for commoners.

s0077.literal: For those who memorialize appointments on their own authority, commissions shall not be issued.
s0077.idiomatic: For those who memorialize appointments on their own authority, commissions shall not be issued.

s0078.literal: Censorate officials said, "Under the general administration of the White Cloud sect in Jiangnan, monks who keep their hair do not support their parents and evade corvée to the people's harm; we request recovery of the conferred imperial letters and silver seals and compulsion to return them to civilian registers.
s0078.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Under the general administration of the White Cloud sect in Jiangnan, monks who keep their hair do not support their parents and evade corvée to the people's harm; we request recovery of the conferred imperial letters and silver seals and compulsion to return them to civilian registers.

s0080.literal: The Fujian Embroidery Artisans and Henan Fish Tax chief commissions were abolished; associate deliberators and adjudication officials of the Bureau of Imperial Manufactures were reduced.
s0080.idiomatic: The Fujian Embroidery Artisans and Henan Fish Tax chief commissions were abolished; associate deliberators and adjudication officials of the Bureau of Imperial Manufactures were reduced.

s0081.literal: On bingyin day a surveillance censor said, "Recently Ministry of Revenue officials devoured the state and threw government into disorder — they have already received proper punishment; their remaining partisan followers spread through all offices — they too must be sifted out in order.
s0081.idiomatic: On bingyin day a surveillance censor said, "Recently Ministry of Revenue officials devoured the state and threw government into disorder — they have already received proper punishment; their remaining partisan followers spread through all offices — they too must be sifted out in order.

s0082.literal: Now the central secretariat memorializes appointing Boluo Temür as Shaanxi grand councillor, Umar as Jiang-Zhe grand councillor, Kölügüs as Gansu grand councillor, Tash Temür as Henan associate administrator, and Wan Seng as Jiang-Zhe associate administrator — in their former posts each accepted heavy bribes or used power to harm the people; all request dismissal.
s0082.idiomatic: Now the central secretariat memorializes appointing Boluo Temür as Shaanxi grand councillor, Umar as Jiang-Zhe grand councillor, Kölügüs as Gansu grand councillor, Tash Temür as Henan associate administrator, and Wan Seng as Jiang-Zhe associate administrator — in their former posts each accepted heavy bribes or used power to harm the people; all request dismissal.

s0084.literal: " On dingmao day Tibetan monks without conferred imperial letters and relay certificates or documents from the Tibetan Pacification Commission were forbidden to come to the capital at will; Yellow River ferry clerks were also admonished to inspect and prohibit them.
s0084.idiomatic: " On dingmao day Tibetan monks without conferred imperial letters and relay certificates or documents from the Tibetan Pacification Commission were forbidden to come to the capital at will; Yellow River ferry clerks were also admonished to inspect and prohibit them.

s0085.literal: The General Directorate and all local monk registries, chief monk offices, and head monk offices were abolished; all litigation among monks was returned to the regular offices.
s0085.idiomatic: The General Directorate and all local monk registries, chief monk offices, and head monk offices were abolished; all litigation among monks was returned to the regular offices.

s0086.literal: The Renchen Court was abolished; the Falconry Chief Commission was restored.
s0086.idiomatic: The Renchen Court was abolished; the Falconry Chief Commission was restored.

s0087.literal: On gengwu day civil and military officials of Jingjiang and Rong Prefecture in Guangxi were ordered: those who kept the frontier secure for three years without incident — civil officials were reduced one grade of rank, military officials promoted one step; this was established as regulation.
s0087.idiomatic: On gengwu day civil and military officials of Jingjiang and Rong Prefecture in Guangxi were ordered: those who kept the frontier secure for three years without incident — civil officials were reduced one grade of rank, military officials promoted one step; this was established as regulation.

s0088.literal: Pacification recruitment officer Tang Quan of the Sizhou Military-Civilian Pacification Commission brought five cave barbarians including Yang Zhengsi to court; gold and silks were granted in graded amounts.
s0088.idiomatic: Pacification recruitment officer Tang Quan of the Sizhou Military-Civilian Pacification Commission brought five cave barbarians including Yang Zhengsi to court; gold and silks were granted in graded amounts.

s0089.literal: A shrine to Bayan, Loyal King of Huai'an, was established at Hangzhou; fields were still granted to supply sacrificial affairs.
s0089.idiomatic: A shrine to Bayan, Loyal King of Huai'an, was established at Hangzhou; fields were still granted to supply sacrificial affairs.

s0090.literal: That month the Emperor said to attendants, "Among commandery and county officials there are good and bad; order censorate officials to select upright men as surveillance commissioners and investigate them; if there are truly those who are incorrupt, capable, and love the people, promote them out of turn — then petty men will know to exert themselves.
s0090.idiomatic: That month the Emperor said to attendants, "Among commandery and county officials there are good and bad; order censorate officials to select upright men as surveillance commissioners and investigate them; if there are truly those who are incorrupt, capable, and love the people, promote them out of turn — then petty men will know to exert themselves.

s0091.literal: " The filial conduct of Wang Chuying, a commoner of Changtai County in Zhang Prefecture, was publicly honored.
s0091.idiomatic: " The filial conduct of Wang Chuying, a commoner of Changtai County in Zhang Prefecture, was publicly honored.

s0092.literal: Third month, gengchen day — former privy council vice director Wu Yuangui, left vice chancellor Baijiang, and Ububadur were summoned to the capital to deliberate affairs jointly with the other elder ministers.
s0092.idiomatic: Third month, gengchen day — former privy council vice director Wu Yuangui, left vice chancellor Baijiang, and Ububadur were summoned to the capital to deliberate affairs jointly with the other elder ministers.

s0093.literal: On bingxu day the moon encroached upon the Upper Chancellor of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0093.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon encroached upon the Upper Chancellor of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0094.literal: The Wutai Branch Works Ministry was abolished.
s0094.idiomatic: The Wutai Branch Works Ministry was abolished.

s0095.literal: On jichou day an order was given not to pardon the ten abominations, great treason, and similar crimes.
s0095.idiomatic: On jichou day an order was given not to pardon the ten abominations, great treason, and similar crimes.

s0096.literal: The Directorate of Auspicious Regalia was restored as the Office of Auspicious Regalia.
s0096.idiomatic: The Directorate of Auspicious Regalia was restored as the Office of Auspicious Regalia.

s0097.literal: On gengyin day the Emperor ascended the throne in the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and all officials; an edict stated:
s0097.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor ascended the throne in the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and all officials; an edict stated:

s0098.literal: Of old the former emperor served the empress dowager and nurtured Our tender person — filial affection and brotherly love reached Heaven's utmost.
s0098.idiomatic: Of old the former emperor served the empress dowager and nurtured Our tender person — filial affection and brotherly love reached Heaven's utmost.

s0099.literal: By this We received the legacy of Our deceased father by succession; further, as the legitimate son of Our mother and younger brother, and with the added merit of pacifying internal crisis — within a month of his accession he conferred the crown prince's treasure upon Us, making Us central secretariat chancellor and privy council commissioner; all weighty affairs of government were left to Our final judgment — for five years until now.
s0099.idiomatic: By this We received the legacy of Our deceased father by succession; further, as the legitimate son of Our mother and younger brother, and with the added merit of pacifying internal crisis — within a month of his accession he conferred the crown prince's treasure upon Us, making Us central secretariat chancellor and privy council commissioner; all weighty affairs of government were left to Our final judgment — for five years until now.

s0100.literal: The former emperor suddenly abandoned the realm; meritorious kin and elder ministers all said that succession to the great treasure, there being already a fixed command, is not comparable to when former sages ascended to Heaven and only then the clansmen were gathered to deliberate whom to install — we should follow the precedents of Zhou, Han, Jin, and Tang and take the correct place upon the imperial throne.
